experiment_plan: AgriVision AI Phase C Task 3.6 — Field Domain Adaptation Proposal
objective: Domain-adapt MobileNetV3 tomato disease classifier from laboratory conditions to authentic field photography while preventing catastrophic forgetting of under-represented classes and preserving diagnostic safety.

splits_isolation.strategy: Stratified random split (80% train, 20% validation) isolated from final benchmark
splits_isolation.final_benchmark_isolation: 163-image benchmark (data/benchmark/) is NEVER accessed during training, validation, or hyperparameter selection

plantvillage_anchor_set.justification: PlantDoc contains 0 samples for Target Spot and only 2 samples for Spider Mites. An anchor set prevents catastrophic forgetting of these two classes and preserves laboratory top-1 accuracy (97.0%).
plantvillage_anchor_set.source: PlantVillage Tomato Dataset (isolated from the 100 benchmark images)

photometric_transforms.comment: Hue jitter is kept minimal (+-0.02) to avoid corrupting diagnostic chlorotic and necrotic lesion colors

prohibited_augmentations: LargeCutout / RandomErasing > 10% (destroys small punctate lesions like Bacterial Spot or Septoria)

stage_1_warmup.description: Backbone frozen, train classifier head only

stage_2_fine_tuning.description: Unfreeze top 4 inverted residual blocks (features 13 to 16)

final_benchmark_guard.eval_timing: Single pass evaluation on the 163-image benchmark only AFTER passing internal gates

benchmark_sample_size_caveats.statistical_interpretation: Due to N=63 on PlantDoc, a 95% Wilson score confidence interval spans approximately +-6 to 12 percentage points. Benchmark results are diagnostic and must be reported with exact counts (k/N) alongside confidence intervals.
